name: Somapacitan
description: A once-weekly growth hormone derivative with a non-covalent albumin-binding side chain, approved for growth hormone deficiency in adults and children.

systems.note: Replaces pituitary somatotropic output on a weekly schedule.
Body-composition effect is a labelled outcome of GH replacement.

monitors.why: Read with IGF-1 to interpret the free fraction.
GH alters peripheral thyroid hormone conversion.
